description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phyrexian Metamorph dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Metamorph that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Phyrexian Metamorph token instead.
